name: Scene
description: Current scene summary: name, path, frame range, object counts and sample, selection, behaviours and license flags. Same data as the get_scene_info tool.

name: Log
description: The last 200 lines of Cascadeur's log file, where Python tracebacks and errors from modify callbacks appear. Read it after an operation that may have failed silently.

name: Timeline
description: Current frame, first and last frame, and animation size of the active scene. Keyframe summaries are added when the timeline tools land (T14).

name: Controllers
description: Control points of the active scene: object names with kind (main_point, direction, box or other) and object type. Character aliases and joints are added when the rig tools land (T12).
